王建新盘腿坐在河边，闭上眼睛，开始运转功法。

灵气在体内转了一个大周天，从丹田出发，沿着脊椎往上，过头顶，顺前面下来，回到丹田。一个周天下来，浑身的疲惫一扫而空，精神饱满得跟睡足了觉似的。炼气三层之后，恢复能力比以前强了太多，几天不睡觉都没问题，一个大周天就能满血复活。

他睁开眼睛，站起来，看着空间里堆积如山的物资，心里美得不行。

“太棒了。”

东西太多了，多得有点发愁。之前做的那个两层大平台，上面堆满了东西，物资压在了小麦苗上。

“看来得需要继续做货架了。”王建新摸了摸下巴，看着那堆物资，“这么多钢材设备，看来可以继续加高嘛，做四层、五层、六层那么高。”

两层不够就做四层，四层不够就做六层。空间的高度是无限的，往上摞就是了。钢材有的是，从莫斯科仓库里收来的那些，够焊一个摩天大楼的。

不过先不急着干活，肚子饿了。

“今天就不做饭了。”王建新走到物资堆那边，翻了翻，找出一罐鱼子酱、几块蛋糕、几根香肠。鱼子酱是红的，装在玻璃罐里，晶莹剔透的。蛋糕是精致的奶油蛋糕，从叶利谢耶夫斯基商店收来的，还新鲜着。香肠是医生香肠，他不知道为什么叫这个名字，但吃着挺香。

王建新坐在沙发上，打开鱼子酱罐子，用小勺舀了一勺放进嘴里。鱼子酱在舌尖上爆开，咸鲜的味道弥漫开来。他又切了一块蛋糕，松软香甜，奶油入口即化。香肠大口咬着，就着鱼子酱和蛋糕，吃得那叫一个美。

吃饱喝足，他又给自己泡了壶茶。茶叶是从叶利谢耶夫斯基收来的锡兰红茶，泡出来颜色红亮，香气浓郁。他端着茶杯，一边喝茶一边观察着空间里的物资。

喝着喝着，他想起来一件事——有好多东西需要放入冰箱、冰柜、冰库。

从莫斯科收来的那些冰箱、冰柜、保鲜柜，里面都装着东西呢。鱼子酱、奶酪、生蚝、鲜肉、水果，这些都需要低温保存。虽然空间里的温度不高不低，但有些东西还是放不住，时间长了会坏。

王建新把所有冰箱、冰柜、保鲜柜全部集中在一起，在火车旁边找了一块平地，一台一台地摆好。冰箱有十几台，冰柜有七八台，保鲜柜也有好几台，大大小小的，排成一圈。他从物资堆里找出发电机，接好线，一台一台地给它们通上电。

冰箱嗡嗡地响起来，里面的灯亮了，温度开始下降。

“别把里边的东西坏了。”王建新检查了一遍，确认所有制冷设备都在正常运转，然后把那些需要低温保存的东西从物资堆里找出来，分类放进冰箱冰柜里。鱼子酱放进保鲜柜，鲜肉放进冷冻柜，水果放进冷藏室，奶酪放进恒温室。

还有一些东西，冰箱冰柜放不下。王建新想到了之前挖的那个地窖冰库。冰库里的冰块还在，盖着棉被和帆布，冻得结结实实的。他把那些放不下的东西——成箱的冷冻肉和海鲜冻鱼，成桶的冰激凌——全部搬进冰库，码得整整齐齐。

忙忙碌碌，把这些弄完就用了好几个小时。

王建新直起腰，看着整整齐齐的冰箱冰柜和满满当当的冰库，心里很有成就感。

外边的火车还在跑着，挺好。他看了看空间外面，天已经黑了，火车在夜色中疾驰，窗外的雪原在月光下泛着银光。不知道到哪儿了，但方向是往西南，往黑海那边去。

“继续干活。”王建新撸起袖子。

他弄来发电机，找来电焊机，接上电，开始焊架子。这次直接在原有的那个两层大平台上继续往高了加。两层不够，加到六层。

钢材不缺。从莫斯科收来的那些钢材，成吨成吨的，堆在空间里占地方，正好用上。电焊机也是这次从莫斯科收来的，苏联产的，功率大，焊得牢。

对于一个修士来说，这现在都是小问题。炼气三层的身体，力量大，耐力强，搬钢材跟搬火柴棍似的。电焊技术他不太熟，焊出来的焊缝虽然不好看，但结实。

“要是有个法术使用就更好了。”王建新一边焊一边想。要是有什么“金属塑形术”之类的法术，意念一动钢材就自己成型了，那得多省事。可惜没有，只能老老实实地焊。

他把所有的钢材开始往上焊接，先焊立柱，再焊横梁，一层一层地往上加。原有的两层平台上面，立起了一根根钢管，纵横交错，形成一个立体的框架。他加固了每一处节点，焊了又焊，确保结实。这样最起码上面放的东西重一些也不怕。

不眠不休，干了两天。

两天里，就没停过手。电焊机的弧光在空间里闪个不停，焊条的烟熏得他满脸黑灰。大毛它们趴在远处看着，不知道主人在干什么，小狐狸缩在沙发上睡大觉。

Wang Jianxin sat cross-legged by the river, closed his eyes, and started to run the exercises.

The spiritual energy circulates in the body for a long time, starting from the Dantian, going up along the spine, over the top of the head, down along the front, and back to the Dantian.At the end of a week, all the fatigue was gone, and I felt as full of energy as if I had had enough sleep.After the third level of Qi refining, the recovery ability is much stronger than before. It doesn't matter if I don't sleep for a few days, and I can be resurrected with full blood in a week.

He opened his eyes, stood up, and looked at the mountains of supplies piled up in the space. He felt so beautiful.

"Awesome."

There are so many things that it’s a bit worrying.The two-story platform we built before was filled with things, and the supplies were weighed down on the wheat seedlings.

"It seems that we need to continue making shelves." Wang Jianxin touched his chin and looked at the pile of materials. "With so much steel equipment, it seems that we can continue to increase the height, making it as high as four, five, or six floors."

If two layers are not enough, make four layers; if four layers are not enough, make six layers.The height of space is infinite, just stack them up.There is plenty of steel. The steel collected from the Moscow warehouse is enough to weld a skyscraper.

But don’t rush to work yet, I’m hungry.

"I won't be cooking today." Wang Jianxin walked to the pile of supplies, rummaged through and found a can of caviar, a few cakes, and a few sausages.The caviar is red, packed in a glass jar, and crystal clear.The cake was a delicate cream cake, collected from the Yeliseyevsky store and still fresh.The sausage was doctor's sausage. He didn't know why it was called that, but it tasted delicious.

Wang Jianxin sat on the sofa, opened the caviar jar, took a spoonful of it with a small spoon and put it into his mouth.The caviar explodes on the tip of the tongue, and the salty taste spreads.He cut another piece of cake. It was soft and sweet, and the cream melted in your mouth.I took a big bite of the sausage, along with the caviar and cake, it was a delicious meal.

After eating and drinking, he made himself a pot of tea.The tea is Ceylon black tea collected from Yeliseyevsky. When brewed, it has a bright red color and a rich aroma.He was holding a tea cup and observing the materials in the space while drinking tea.

While drinking, he remembered one thing - there were many things that needed to be put into the refrigerator, freezer, and freezer.

The refrigerators, freezers, and crispers we received from Moscow are all filled with things.Caviar, cheese, oysters, fresh meat, and fruits all require low-temperature storage.Although the temperature in the space is neither high nor low, some things still cannot be stored and will break down over time.

Wang Jianxin gathered all the refrigerators, freezers, and fresh cabinets together, found a flat area next to the train, and placed them one by one.There are more than a dozen refrigerators, seven or eight freezers, and several fresh-keeping cabinets, large and small, arranged in a circle.He found generators from the pile of supplies, connected them, and powered them on one by one.

The refrigerator hummed, the lights inside came on, and the temperature began to drop.

"Don't break the things inside." Wang Jianxin checked it over and confirmed that all the refrigeration equipment was operating normally. Then he took out the things that needed to be stored at low temperature from the pile of supplies and put them into the refrigerator and freezer by category.Caviar is put in the fresh-keeping cabinet, fresh meat is put in the freezer, fruit is put in the refrigerator, and cheese is put in the constant temperature room.

There are also some things that cannot fit in the refrigerator and freezer.Wang Jianxin thought of the cellar ice storage he dug before.The ice cubes in the icehouse are still there, covered with quilts and canvas, and they are frozen solid.He moved everything that couldn't fit into the freezer - boxes of frozen meat, seafood and fish, buckets of ice cream - into the icehouse and stacked them neatly.

I was so busy that it took me several hours to finish this.

Wang Jianxin straightened up and looked at the neat refrigerators and freezers and the full freezer, feeling very accomplished.

The train outside is still running, which is good.He looked outside the space. It was already dark, the train was speeding through the night, and the snowfield outside the window shone silvery in the moonlight.I don’t know where I am, but my direction is southwest, toward the Black Sea.

"Keep working." Wang Jianxin rolled up his sleeves.

He got a generator, found a welding machine, connected it to electricity, and started welding the frame.This time, we continued to build higher on the original two-story platform.Two layers are not enough, so add six layers.

There is no shortage of steel.The tons of steel collected from Moscow were piled in the space to take up space, just in time for use.The electric welding machine was also collected from Moscow this time. It is made in the Soviet Union. It has high power and can weld firmly.

For a monk, this is now a small problem.A body at the third level of Qi Refining has great strength and endurance, and can move steel like a matchstick.He was not very familiar with electric welding technology. Although the welded seams were not beautiful, they were strong.

"It would be better if there was a spell to use." Wang Jianxin thought while welding.It would be much easier if there was some magic like "Metal Shaping", where the steel would shape itself with just a thought.It's a pity that I don't have it, so I can only weld it honestly.

He started welding all the steel upwards, first welding the columns, then welding the beams, layer by layer.On the original two-story platform, steel pipes were erected, criss-crossing to form a three-dimensional frame.He reinforced every joint and welded again and again to ensure it was strong.This way at least you won't have to worry if the things placed on top are heavier.

I worked without sleep for two days.

For two days, I didn't stop.The arc light of the welding machine kept flashing in the space, and the smoke from the welding rod made his face black and gray.Big Mao and the others lay watching from a distance, not knowing what their master was doing. The little fox curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
